description: Link followed while durable storage is unavailable.

expected_upstream.notes: Upstream ignores the send result and redirects; a failed write is silent.

expected_holocron.notes: Redirect still sent; the hit is not stored and increments lost_hits, shown in link reports (docs/decisions/0005, links and pixels during a storage outage).

validation_reason: Needs a storage fault injected into Holocron.
